ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High contrast ratio. Approximately 85% of the visible surface consists of high-intensity white pixels (central regions) bounded by 15% low-intensity black pixels located at the distal tips, trailing edges, and a vertical median streak.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Primary white contiguous zone across both lobes. Low-intensity black bands define the entire trailing edge and tips. A distinct vertical dark pigmentation streak is located at the center-right of the median notch. Multiple isolated low-intensity circular clusters are scattered across the interior white fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an approximate 40-degree angle, showing a deep indentation between the two lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations across the entire trailing edge. Right lobe (viewer perspective) shows deeper sawtooth peaks compared to the left lobe. Amplitude of serrations increases significantly toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave upward sweep originating from the median notch, transitioning to a convex curve toward the outer distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular pixel clusters distributed across the ventral surface. Left lobe contains several 'O-shaped' rings with white centers. Right lobe features solid dark circular spots and localized clusters of high-contrast white dots near the tips.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint vertical linear streaks near the base and center of the fluke lobes, likely corresponding to surface creases or pigmentation irregularities.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct semi-circular missing tissue segment (excision) on the upper trailing edge of the right lobe. Visible clusters of three-dimensional calcified structures (barnacles) at the lateral tips of both flukes.
other_distinctive_markers: Highly irregular pigmentation patch extending vertically from the bottom edge towards the center-right of the notch, distinct from the uniform black trailing edge border.
